name: HAITIAN DOMINOES
description: Haitian Dominoes is a 4-player partnership domino game using a double-six set. Teams race to build a 4-point streak where losing a round resets the loser score to zero.

content.text: Haitian Dominoes is a 4-player partnership domino game using a double-six set. Teams race to build a 4-point streak where losing a round resets the loser score to zero.
Haitian Dominoes is part of Caribbean partnership domino traditions and is documented as a mainstream social game in Haiti.
Exactly 4 players in fixed partnerships; partners sit opposite.
One double-six domino set (28 tiles), shuffled face down.

Each player draws 7 tiles. Any player with 5 or more doubles may demand a full reshuffle and redeal. In first round, holder of the double-six tile starts by playing it. In later rounds, a member of the team that won the previous round starts.

items.text: No Gestures: Championship or strict tables disallow partner gestures during play.
Three-Point Dekabes After Tie: Some tables score 3 (not 4) for Dekabes immediately after a tied blocked round.
Redeal Threshold Variant: Some groups use a different minimum number of doubles needed to force reshuffle.
